summary: Petition seeking approval under Section 17(3) and Section 17(4) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Article 15.2.2 of the Transmission Service Agreement dated 09.02.2024, for creation of security interest by way of hypothecation of the assets of Karera Power Transmisión Limited in favour of the Respondent No. 2, i.e., Axis Trustee Services Limited, the Security Trustee of the Lender(s). **Parties present:** Shri Aniket Prasoon, Advocate, KPTL Md. Aman Sheikh, Advocate, KPTL Shri Adarsh Kumar Bhardwaj, Advocate, KPTL Ms. Priyanshi Singh, Advocate, KPTL 2. The Petitioner has filed the present Petition for approval for the creation and perfection of a Security Interest in terms of Financing Document through the hypothecation/ mortgage/ charge/ pledge /assignment (as applicable), over all assets, and all the movable and immovable assets, Transmission Project accounts, Project Documents (including assignment of transmission licence) etc., both present and future, of the Petitioner in favour of the Axis Trustee Services Limited (Respondent No. 2). Additionally, the Petitioner has requested for the approval of documents that create security as well as other documents pertaining to the facility. The Petitioner has made the following prayers: _“(a) approve the creation of the security interest by the Petitioner over the Hypothecated Properties to the extent described in this Petition in favour of Respondent No. 2 i.e., Axis Trustee Services Limited for the benefit of the Lender, to secure the Secured Obligations;_ _(b) approve the creation of the security interest by the Petitioner over the Hypothecated Properties to the extent described in this Petition for the benefit of the Lender and for its successors, subsequent transferees, novatees, assigns and any refinancing lenders to the Project by way of hypothecation/ assignment/ mortgage (if any);_ _(c) approve and allow the execution of the Unattested Deed of Hypothecation and Power of Attorney for Hypothecation for creation and perfection of the security interest to the extent described in this Petition in favour of the Respondent No. 2 i.e., Axis Trustee Services Limited._ _(e) pass any such order, further relief(s) in the facts and circumstances of the case as this Hon’ble Commission may deem just and equitable in favour of the Petitioner."_ 3. The Petitioner, KPTL, is a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013. Respondent no. 2 i.e., Axis Trustee Services Limited (hereinafter referred to as the “Security Trustee”), who is acting as the Security Trustee for the purpose of holding the securities on behalf of and for benefit of the lender i.e., Respondent No. 3, Standard Chartered Bank, and any other banks and financial institutions participating in the facility (hereinafter referred to as the “Lender(s)/ SCB/ Lender’s Agent”), in terms of the Security Trustee Agreement dated 26.9.2025. 5. The Petitioner has submitted that pursuant to the terms of the Loan Agreement, the Petitioner has agreed to secure the Secured Obligations in favour of the Security Trustee acting on behalf of the Lender(s)/ SCB as per the terms set out therein. The relevant extract of the Facility Agreement is set out below: - (iv) all of the Borrower's rights, title, interest, benefits, claims and demands under each of the Project Documents, alias amended, varied or supplemented from time to time (duly acknowledged and consented to by the relevant counter-parties to such Project Documents, all as amended, varied or supplemented from time to time; 6. The Petitioner has submitted that in terms of the Financing Documents, the Petitioner is required to create security, which is the transaction security (as defined under the Facility Agreement), in favour of a Security Trustee for the benefit of the lender. 8. The Petitioner has stated that in view of the provisions of sub-sections (3) and (4) of Section 17 of the Act, the Petitioner, as a licensee, cannot create a Security Interest over all the movable and immovable assets of the Petitioner in favour of a Security Trustee acting on behalf of lender pursuant to a Facility Agreement dated 26.9.2025 and a Security Trustee Agreement dated 26.9.2025 without approval of the Commission. Accordingly, the Petitioner has filed the present Petition seeking prior approval of the Commission for the creation of a Security Interest over all assets, including the movable and immovable assets for the Project in favour of the Security Trustee pursuant to a Security Trustee Agreement and a Facility Agreement. **Hearing dated 26.2.2026** 9. The Petition was called out for the hearing on 26.2.2026 after notice to the Respondents. Vide Record of Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as "RoP") dated 26.02.2026, the Respondents were granted an opportunity to file their respective replies. The Petitioner was further directed to file, by way of an affidavit, the details of actual application (utilisation) and sources of funds as on the date of filing of the Petition in the prescribed format. 11. During the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that the Petitioner has complied with the directions issued vide the RoP dated 26.2.2026 and has furnished the details of application of funds and sources of funds as on the date of the Petition. The learned counsel also submitted that none of the Respondents has filed any reply in the matter. Considering the submissions of the parties, the matter was reserved for order. _“17. (3) No licensee shall any time assign his licence or transfer his utility, or any part hereof, by sale, lease, exchange or otherwise without the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission._ financing documents of the Project. The Petitioner is directed to submit a signed copy of the Indenture of Mortgage for the Project immediately after its execution.
